description: Update an existing Zendesk macro by ID. The title and actions are required and sent on every update; description, active status, and access restrictions can also be supplied.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for updating a Zendesk macro.

actions.description: List of actions the macro will perform. Each action specifies a field to modify and the value to set.
actions.human_parameter_description: What the macro does when applied (e.g., set status to solved, set priority to normal).

items.description: A single action that the macro will perform.

field.description: The field to modify. Common fields: 'status', 'priority', 'assignee_id', 'group_id', 'tags', 'type'.
field.human_parameter_description: The ticket field to change (e.g., status, priority, assignee_id, group_id).
field.title: Field

value.description: The value to set for the field. Can be a string (e.g., 'solved', 'normal'), number, or boolean depending on the field type.
value.human_parameter_description: The new value for the field (e.g., 'solved' for status, 'normal' for priority).
value.title: Value

items.title: MacroActionItem

actions.title: Actions

active.description: Whether the macro should be displayed in the UI. Use false to hide the macro without deleting it.
active.human_parameter_description: Set to true to show the macro or false to hide it.
active.title: Active

description.description: The description of the macro explaining what it does.
examples: Sets the ticket status to solved
description.title: Description

macro_id.description: The ID of the macro to update. You can find macro IDs from the List Macros action or from the macro URL in Zendesk admin.
macro_id.human_parameter_description: The unique ID of the Zendesk macro you want to update. This is a required path parameter.
macro_id.title: Macro Id

restriction.description: Who may access the macro. Null when everyone in the account can access it.
restriction.human_parameter_description: Limit macro access to specific users or groups.

id.description: The ID of the user or group that has access
id.title: Id

ids.description: Array of IDs that have access
ids.title: Ids

type.description: The type of restriction: 'User', 'Group', or null for everyone
type.title: Type

restriction.title: MacroRestriction

name: update_macro
